merge_policy: Two differently worded items are one finding when they name the same spec defect with the same fix target (which spec sentence/section the fix lands in); split by fix-target and defect class. This is T632's documented dedup rule (findings/T632-race-f-grade.json, union_recall.reference_union), applied here to the five source audits; the canonical union is T632's canonical_items, so Race A and Race F reduce against the same graded reference union.
notes: Race A = the five independent read-only audits of the S04 reconciler spec: T584 (claude-opus-5), T588 (claude-sonnet-5), T589 (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001), T590 (deepseek-v4-flash), T614 (claude-fable-5). The same five audits, anonymized and hash-shuffled, are untracked/race-f/lanes/lane-{1..5}.json (sealed key untracked/race-grading/race-f/KEY.json, sha256-verified on this host 2026-08-22). Lane->model attribution read from that key; the reduction itself is model-agnostic. Verdicts and canonical statements transcribed from T632's union_recall.canonical_items. The mappings below are the T637 reduction's merge decisions, made by reading each audit finding against the canonical items; counts are derived mechanically from this list by the tool. Costs (total tokens incl. cache+reasoning) from untracked/tokens/tokens.jsonl dispatch-time ledger; deepseek lanes have no structured usage and are stated unknown, never estimated. T632 was amended mid-flight to keep caught_by/missed_by per union item; its per_entrant prose was transcribed here for the Race F input (tools/complementarity-inputs/race-f.json), which uses the direct caught_by form.
